permitted_scope: Source-image construction, analytic benchmarks and reprojection diagnostics only. No new kinematic response scoring.
reason: The available maps support a restricted flat separable disk experiment. Absolute photometry, source noise likelihood, vertical structure and all baryon phases are not fully validated.
spatial_family: rho(X,Y,z) = Sigma(X,Y) exp(-abs(z)/h)/(2h); fixed flat orientation; no bulge, flare or warp inferred
forward_equation: J(X,Y) = cos(i) I_sky(X,Y cos(i)) = integral Sigma(X,Y-z tan(i)) exp(-abs(z)/h)/(2h) dz
projected_kernel: two-sided exponential in disk-plane minor coordinate with scale h tan(i)
native_beam_scope: Infer only an effective beam-blurred planar source. For a fixed linear beam and flat geometry, spatial convolution commutes with the vertical projection. No instrumental deconvolution is claimed.

source_fit.weights: clipped area coverage, not inverse measurement covariance

benchmarks.threshold_scope: 5 percent flags a construction mismatch for follow-up; it is not a noise-calibrated likelihood acceptance criterion.

source_response_classification.source: S4G P5 cleaned stellar image/ICA mask, THINGS released HI moment zero, HERACLES signed CO/error maps; restricted source-001 pixel packet
source_response_classification.prior_exposure: NGC2903 is already development-exposed in earlier work; no pristine holdout claim.

remaining_admission_gates: Absolute and spatial photometric calibration, independently propagated source covariance, and recovered raw geometry source files.
Pixel-footprint and source-beam convergence beyond the restricted effective-resolution model.
Missing gas phases, conversion uncertainties and physically allowed thickness/warp/bulge/exterior-field ensembles.
Prospective complete builder/solver admission before any further motion comparison.
